caption: The drawing depicts a single lantern placed on a plain, light beige background. The lantern is constructed from a combination of materials indicated by colors and shading: it features brown and copper hues on its metal components with a handle at the top, a domed lid, a cylindrical midsection, and a flared base. The lantern’s main body is made of transparent, wavy glass through which the cylindrical metal base is visible. Surrounding the glass section are several thin, curved metal wires forming a protective cage-like structure attached at the top and base. The handle at the very top is circular and also brown. There is no flame or light source visible within the lantern, and the drawing makes use of subtle shading and highlights to suggest the metallic and glass textures. The composition centers the lantern with no other objects present.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
